proves.claim: clause 1: editItem with a specs argument and a reason replaces an open item's cited spec rows, refreezes its bar with the new rows' text and records one edit move; without specs the rows are untouched.

store.io-board-edit-specs.replaces-rows-.why: Without this test an item filed against the wrong spec rows could only be withdrawn and refiled.

proves.claim: clause 1: editItem refuses an empty, repeated or reasonless specs list and changes nothing.

store.io-board-edit-specs.refuses-bad-li.why: Without this test a malformed list could blank an item's cited rows or change them with no recorded reason.
